te: At least 73,000 people die in the 1718 Tongwei–Gansu earthquake due to landslides in the Qing dynasty.
dz: 至少有73 000人死于1718年的"通威" 清朝因山体滑坡而发生甘肃地震.

de: Alexei Petrovich, Tsarevich of Russia, Peter the Great's son, mysteriously dies after being sentenced to death by his father for plotting against him.

te: Royal Navy Lieutenant Robert Maynard attacks and boards the vessels of the British pirate Edward Teach (best known as "…
dz: 英国皇家海军中尉罗伯特·梅纳德在北卡罗来纳州海岸袭击并登上了英国海盗爱德华·蒂奇（最著名的“黑胡子”）的船只。双方伤亡包括梅纳德的大副海德先生和蒂奇本人。
de: Royal Navy Lieutenant Robert Maynard attacks and boards the vessels of the British pirate Edward Teach (best known as "Blackbeard") off the coast of North Carolina. The casualties on both sides include Maynard's first officer Mister Hyde and Teach himself.

dz: 大北方战争：瑞典国王查理十二世在围攻挪威腓特烈斯滕堡垒时身亡。
de: Great Northern War: King Charles XII of Sweden dies during a siege of the fortress of Fredriksten in Norway.
